name: miru
description: Inline review tool for AI-generated md/HTML — select text or click elements, leave comments, fully local.

scripts.dev: bun run build:front && bun run packages/cli/src/cli.ts
scripts.build:front: bun build packages/frontend/src/index.tsx --outfile packages/server/src/assets/miru.js --production && cp packages/frontend/src/miru.css packages/server/src/assets/miru.css
scripts.build: bun run build:front && bun build --compile packages/cli/src/cli.ts --outfile miru && bun run scripts/clean-build.ts
